items: You can now mark interest in external calendar events, with your choice kept in sync across event views.
External events you’re participating in now appear alongside internal events in the home feed.
The timeline groups events by the event’s local date, making day headings accurate across time zones.
Event details are organized into clearer location, participation, and description panels.
Event descriptions safely display formatted text and automatically turn web addresses into links.
Member selectors and role displays have improved spacing, wrapping, and refresh behavior.
Calendar sync removes events that are no longer available and ignores external events that do not have a scheduled time.
Interest forms now show clearer errors when an external event is unavailable in the current space.
